title.narrative: HIV and AIDS prevention program for vulnerable and key populations - Gambia (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Gambia, TB/HIV, ActionAid International The Gambia (AAITG)This program has the following goals: To accelerate the achievement of the 95-95-95 targets in line with our national, regional, and global commitment. To enhance universal access to quality and responsive patient centered TB services towards ending the TB epidemic in the Gambia. The objectives of this program are: Increase the proportion of PLHIV who know their status from 56% in 2022 to 95% by 2026;. Increase the proportion of PLHIV on treatment from 65% in 2022 to 95% by 2026;. Increase the proportion of PLHIV on treatment who are virally supressed from 26% in 2022 to 95% by 2026;. Ensure Zero stigma and discrimination and enhance the human rights of PLHIV; and. Facilitate a Sustainable National Response to HIV and AIDS
